tools.name: search_federated
tools.description: Search the registered public CityScroll lenses in one bounded result set. Optional scope selects only allowlisted registered lenses. Preserves per-lens coverage, source observations, exact object routes, and federated ranking; it does not expose a raw store or arbitrary query language.

query.description: Resident search terms, up to 240 characters.

scope.description: Closed allowlist of registered federation lenses. Omit to search every registered lens.

tools.name: search_notices
tools.description: Search NYC City Record notices (the daily-refreshed mirror). Keyword terms are OR-matched; add structured filters to narrow. Amounts are validity-filtered (data-entry errors excluded); rolling placeholder deadlines are labeled, never shown as dates.

section.description: Exact section, e.g. 'Procurement', 'Public Hearings and Meetings', 'Agency Rules'.

min_amount.description: Minimum contract amount in dollars (Award notices only carry amounts).

open_only.description: Only notices whose due date hasn't passed.

tools.name: get_notice
tools.description: Get one public City Record notice by its exact RequestID. The result preserves materialized-source freshness and distinguishes a missing public notice from a read that cannot be served.

tools.name: get_entity_dossier
tools.description: Get the bounded public dossier for one exact canonical CityScroll entity. Preserves attributed disagreements, availability, provenance, and public redaction.

tools.name: get_entity_relationships
tools.description: Traverse bounded, evidence-bearing public relationships from one exact canonical CityScroll entity. Only the closed node and edge vocabularies are returned.

tools.name: retrieve_cited_passages
tools.description: Retrieve source passages with stable citations and exact source joins. Returns source text only; it does not generate an answer or infer civic relationships.

tools.name: get_contract
tools.description: Get one public contract by its exact ID. Uses the same Contracts record as CityScroll. Includes source links, coverage, freshness, amount validity, and lifecycle facts when available.

procurement_id.description: Exact canonical procurement_id, including its procurement: prefix.

tools.name: browse_contracts
tools.description: List public Contracts records with bounded filters and pages. Results keep exact contract IDs separate, including records that share a PIN.

query.description: Case-insensitive terms matched against the existing Contracts browse fields.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

tools.name: analyze_contracts
tools.description: Rank groups by agency, vendor, fiscal year, or amount band. Uses the registered-contract population. Reports registered value or contract count, a scope denominator, coverage, and exact contract IDs. Does not report payments or spending.

measure.description: current or original registered contract value, or unique contract count.

output.measure: current registered contract value in USD

tools.name: get_person_or_organization
tools.description: Get one exact typed person or organization row from the published People and organizations read model. Display names never create identity; relation states and source fields are preserved.

entity_id.description: Exact row id such as official:... or agency:id:...

tools.name: browse_organizations
tools.description: Browse the bounded typed People and organizations snapshot with exact row-kind and token filters. Results retain published, empty, or unknown relation states and read-model freshness.

tools.name: get_meeting
tools.description: Get one exact source-qualified meeting from the shared CityScroll meeting read model. Preserves source receipt, coverage, freshness, and attached meeting documents.

meeting_id.description: Exact canonical meeting id, including its meeting: prefix.

tools.name: get_land_project
tools.description: Get one exact Land (ZAP) project by its ZAP project id. Includes its deep link, status, geography, applicant, review procedure, exact actions and ids, environmental facts, milestones, outcomes, sources, and any conflicts, when known.

project_id.description: Exact publisher ZAP project id, e.g. 2024Q0356.

tools.name: browse_land_projects
tools.description: List public Land (ZAP) projects using the same filters as the Land page: review procedure, action type, stage, effect, and geography. Reads the full warehouse, not just active projects, so completed and past projects stay reachable too.

status.description: Exact publisher public/project status, e.g. 'public:Noticed' or 'project:Active'. Omit for every status — never active-only.

query.description: Case-insensitive terms matched against the existing Land browse row text.

community_district.description: Borough-lettered community district substring, e.g. K02.

corpus.description: 'live' (default) reads the current committed complete warehouse. 'historical' reads the frozen four-project expedited-procedure regression corpus, for reproducible verification.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

output.fixedPopulation: none — reflects the current committed warehouse

tools.name: preview_watch
tools.description: Preview what a plain-English standing watch would deliver, without subscribing. Lens: money (procurement), land (rezonings), property, rules, meetings, people.

request.description: Plain-English description, e.g. 'construction awards over $1M from Parks'.

tools.name: create_watch
tools.description: Create a standing email watch from plain English. The watch starts immediately; the welcome email states its scope and includes manage and unsubscribe links.

request.description: Plain-English description of what to watch.
